#_focus-exit: Focus-mode exit pill. Its family is declared only inside the .app._focus-mode branch (styles.css:1308), so in the default state -- which is what this walk measures -- it carries no author family at all. Sidebar/chrome family, W4.
#_focus-toggle: Focus-mode toggle in the sidebar. W4 (sidebar geometry) owns this surface; re-facing it moves pixels in the seven baselines the sidebar appears in.
(unclassed)@body: The six search-overlay result buttons, built with inline styles in search-overlay.js. Real, and outside a home-identity wave: the fix belongs with whoever next opens that file.
cmp-fold: Companion fold control. Sidebar/companion family -- W4.
cmp-rel: Companion related-topic buttons. Sidebar/companion family -- W4.
cmp-reopen: Companion reopen tab. Sidebar/companion family -- W4.
crambtn: Cram-sheet buttons, 14 of them, visible on every topic route. The single largest remaining surface -- and the reason this is a ratchet and not a big-bang fix: it is present in most of the 16 VR baselines, so it needs its own reviewed rebaseline. W4.
mock-x: Mock-run close buttons (7, all inside closed overlays). Mock/cram family.
nd-m: Continue-dock Missed/Shaky/Solid slot. Dock family -- W1/W4 touched this dock; the family declaration was never part of it.
scrolltop: Scroll-to-top FAB. Its glyph is an arrow, so the visible effect is small, but the declaration is the same defect. W4.
tn-item: Topic-nav dropdown items, 46 of them (0-size until the menu opens). Topic-nav family -- W4.
tn-step: Topic-nav prev/next stepper. Topic-nav family -- W4.
tn-trigger: The topic-nav trigger itself. Topic-nav family -- W4.
tools-fab: Tools floating action button. Sidebar tools -- W4.
